summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, attaching an amended and restated Canadian material change report originally dated June 9, 2026, correcting disclosure on a December 22, 2025 restructuring transaction. NuRAN closed the issuance of 10,380,618 units at $2.89 per unit for about $30 million, including a $20.8 million debt settlement tied to the acquisition of Advance Factoring Inc., plus a 2,115,064-unit initial tranche for roughly $6.11 million. The Factor's vendors received shares representing 55.78% of outstanding voting securities, constituting a restructuring transaction under NI 51-102. Watch for Canadian regulatory default resolution and any resulting control or overhang implications.
